news-korea-econ.title: Leftist South Korean President Hits Lowest-Ever Approval After Trump Iran Dispute
news-korea-econ.description:
A poll published on Monday found leftist South Korean President Lee Jae-myung marking an approval rating of only 40.2 percent, the lowest documented since he came to power in a special election in 2025.
